description: This file defines the LogFragment class, an Android Fragment that manages a LogView to display logs within an app. It handles setting up the log view UI, including padding, typeface, and scroll behavior, and updates the scroll position when log content changes.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that displays log messages through a custom LogView, providing UI setup and automatic scrolling behavior.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView, setting properties like padding, typeface, and gravity, then returns the assembled view hierarchy.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Initializes the fragment's view, sets a TextWatcher to auto-scroll on new log entries, and returns the root view.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance used within the fragment.
